# Compliance

Security and compliance are critical for your business, and we take both seriously. This page describes Laravel Nightwatch's current compliance status.

## Current compliance status

### SOC 2 Type 2

SOC 2 is a compliance framework developed by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA). A Type 2 report assesses the design and operating effectiveness of an organization's controls over an audit period.

Laravel Nightwatch has completed a SOC 2 Type 2 audit. Access to the report can be requested through the [Laravel Trust Center](https://trust.laravel.com/?product=nightwatch).

### ISO 27001

Laravel Nightwatch is covered by Laravel's ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification. This internationally recognized standard specifies requirements for an information security management system. The certificate is listed in the [Laravel Trust Center](https://trust.laravel.com/?product=nightwatch).

## Security documentation

The [Laravel Trust Center](https://trust.laravel.com/?product=nightwatch) provides current compliance information, security policies, and a list of subprocessors. Access to restricted documents, including the SOC 2 report and penetration test report, can be requested using the **Get access** button.

## Stay updated

We update this page as our compliance status changes. If you have questions about our compliance status, contact [nightwatch@laravel.com](mailto:nightwatch@laravel.com).
